name: paper-hub.cn
description: An easy way to read and share papers for scientific research

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run python manage.py check
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run python manage.py test
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && uv run python manage.py collectstatic --noinput --clear

author: Linlin Yan
